answer: One concrete defense is staked identity with aging. Every new agent must lock a deposit and wait a fixed window before its attestations count toward rewards. A spiral of throwaway agents spun up in bulk would tie up real capital for weeks, so the cost of each fake identity grows with the attack. Peers also weight votes by the stake and track record of the attester, so a crystal clear history of honest work counts for more than raw account numbers. New nodes without proof stay in the umber shadows of consensus until they earn trust.
